support_claim: Compatible short-name versus Inc. billing labels do not satisfy the identity burden, and the packet explicitly preserves unresolved registry ambiguity including a separate Wyoming LLC, so neither SAME_ENTITY nor DISTINCT is established.

steps.fact: CRM account NBA-102 is recorded under the name "Northbridge Analytics".
Billing invoices list the billed name as "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
Commercial notes state that sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc."

Commercial notes report a 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC "Northbridge Analytics LLC" and legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party; the registry link is to be treated as unresolved.
The packet provides no shared legal identifier (e.g., EIN, registration number) linking crm:NBA-102 to billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc., and does not license identifier uniqueness for any field.
Name overlap and naming conventions are compatible but do not establish identity; absence of identity evidence does not establish distinctness.
